dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: First-time guests, please register your lodgings over here! We still have some vacancies for Huha Hill villas with an ocean view...

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, dear guest. I trust your stay has been enjoyable?

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Of course. And, I remember one of your companions received an Asha's favor the instant he set foot on the island. Are they still getting along well?

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: That's a relief. Although Asha can be quite friendly around people, this is the first time I've seen one so enthusiastic about making a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: In any case, I wish you and your friend a wonderful summer.
